source: Hygon Information Technology results briefing Q&A: Q3 2026 (10-22-2026)

players.product: x86-compatible server CPUs (Hygon 7000 / 5000 / 3000 series) and DCU GPGPU accelerators (8000 series) for servers and data centers

quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (Q3 2026 results briefing): general manager Sha Chaoqun and chairman Li Jun said the CPU and DCU businesses are growing fast and, as AI-industry demand keeps rising, Q4 and full-year revenue and profit are expected to keep growing; Sha said orders on hand are ample, the stocked inventory will convert gradually into revenue and cash flow in Q4 and later years, and there is no obvious risk of an inventory backlog. Li said the slight quarter-to-quarter swings in customer demand do not change the overall growth trend. Sha also said that because domestic models are being deeply adapted to domestic chips, demand for the company's products in AI compute keeps climbing.
quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology results briefing Q&A: Q3 2026 (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Stocking and pricing (Q3 2026 results briefing): CFO and board secretary Xu Wenchao said inventory rose from RMB 64 hundred million at the start of the year to RMB 89 hundred million to secure delivery and lock in upstream capacity, the asset impairment reflects prudent provisioning on part of that larger inventory, and rapid growth, rising memory prices and strong demand call for strategic stocking and locking in upstream capacity. Chairman Li Jun said customer prepayments are not the usual settlement method but project-specific arrangements by some customers, so contract liabilities fell as those orders were delivered. General manager Sha Chaoqun said the company will respond to upstream raw-material price swings by raising product selling prices, optimising product configurations, tighter supply-chain control and scale-driven cost cuts.

quarterly_data.signal: Margins and costs (Q3 2026 results briefing): CFO Xu Wenchao said Q3 gross margin recovered from Q2 mainly on a better product mix, Q3 revenue grew both YoY and QoQ, and the QoQ profit swing came from deliberately higher R&D spending and product-mix changes; selling expenses grew fast because the sales team expanded and the company stepped up customer introduction and channel investment during the competitive window in China's domestic compute market.
quarterly_data.quarter: Hygon Information Technology results briefing Q&A: Q3 2026 (10-22-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Products (Q3 2026 results briefing): chairman Li Jun said R&D of the next-generation general-purpose CPU and DCU is advancing on the planned roadmap and on schedule, with significant upgrades in compute density and interconnect bandwidth; general manager Sha Chaoqun said the Hygon-5 CPU and Shensuan-4 DCU are progressing smoothly (no launch date given). Sha said the 1000-series edge CPU was released on September 22, after the company visited more than 30 core partners covering nearly 20 industries, with some complete-system designs started before chip mass production; edge revenue will build gradually and will not change the short-term revenue structure.
